content:
maria: Heads-up: vendor invoice INV-5519 netted a $9,600 'reseller pass-through' credit against a customer invoice. AR dropped and month-end revenue for April looks understated.

kevin: Do we have contract language that the vendor will credit us vs the customer?

maria: Not in Ops note. Sales confirms a separate promotional pilot of $30k but vendor rebate appears unrelated.

jin: Accounting treatment options: (1) treat as contra-revenue (if vendor intended credit to customer) or (2) treat as vendor rebate reducing hosting expense. Evidence required. For close, propose temporary adjusting JEs to preserve customer revenue until vendor clarifies.

rosa: Proposed temp JEs to post today: 
DR Accounts Receivable 9,600  CR Sales Allowances 9,600  (restate AR to original)
and post vendor rebate placeholder: 
DR Accounts Payable - Vendor Credits 9,600  CR Other Income - Vendor Rebates 9,600
Include ticket link and vendor email in memo.

kevin: Also need proration for Sales pilot $30k effective 2026-04-12 for 60 days (4/12-6/10). Allocation: Apr 19/60=9,500.00? Wait calc: Apr 12-30 inclusive = 19 days -> 19/60*30,000 = 9,500.00; May 31/60*30,000 = 15,500.00; Jun 10/60*30,000 = 5,000.00.

maria: Good. Action items: Rosa to post the temporary JEs and attach ticket BILL-778; Jin to update revenue schedule for the $30k pilot; Kevin to obtain vendor confirmation and corrected invoice. Billing-bot: create HOLD on INV-5519.

billing-bot: Announcement: invoice INV-5519 flagged for manual review. Ticket BILL-778 created.

maria: I'll review the JE memos during close and sign off if vendor confirms within 5 business days.

rosa: Will post JEs and attach ticket by EOD.

kevin: If vendor confirms rebate is to customer, we'll reverse the JEs and book contra-revenue.

maria: Thanks team.
